facts.fact: The African Development Bank, a development finance institution, approved in January 2025 a $160 million senior corporate loan to AXIAN Telecom (Mauritius-headquartered) across nine countries, of which over $10 million is dedicated to 22,000 women entrepreneurs in Madagascar through the MVola platform; AfDB's own release of 31 January 2025.
facts.system: AfDB senior corporate loan to AXIAN Telecom (MVola women entrepreneurs component)
